REPORT-ONLY on its own: this cell makes no admission claim and carries no bar; its deliverable is a margin table.

modules.why: Greedy decoding at temperature 0 is not bit-reproducible across batch compositions (the 2026-09-04 finding), so a second pass of an identical request measures the decode noise this roster's paired estimator actually carries. Importing a margin from TRAIN Fold A would import a different roster, a different gold split, a different scorer sibling and a different clustering.

prepared_phase_supply.note: Item E16: a prepared artifact is evidence only for the implementation that produced it, so each of the five flown cells (PLANr-DEV2000, arm, twin and the two smokes) prepares its OWN first-phase Perception supply under its OWN run id at the readiness flip. core.flight.repin.ensure_artifact_pinned runs core.flight.cli prepare-supply (model-free, zero model / tokenizer / encoder / scorer / server contacts), writes the pin into the baseline fragment and inserts the matching preparation readiness requirement. The committed baselines therefore carry NO prepared_phase_supply key at all -- the cell-P0 form. A PENDING_ string in its place is NOT a valid registration: core.flight.repin.ArtifactPin.from_mapping refuses it before the preparation step can run.
